title: What remains together?

doesNotKnow: Before disturbance the toy bones are connected. Afterwards they are scattered. Scattered remains can have many causes: this example illustrates one stipulated process, not proof that a scavenger acted at a real site.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: In the pictured toy sequence, a scavenger displaces several bones after death. Which arrangement is harder to interpret as an intact body?
